description: The shipped default-UI panel manifest: panel key -> the scene that serves it, plus the Insimul modules (band 111, conformance/modules/genre-activation.json) a panel needs before it is offered at all. This file is DATA on purpose — insimul_ui_registry.gd resolves through it and spells no panel key and no module id, so adding or gating a panel is a data change, not an engine change. Keys mirror conformance/ui/registry-cases.json -> panel_keys; tools/verify-ui/check-ui.mjs holds the two to each other and checks every scene and every module id.
